test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: With which of the following tournaments is hockey associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rangaswamy Cup.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rangaswamy Cup** is associated with** hockey. **
 
• The **Rangaswami Cup **was **first held in 1928** as an Inter-Provincial Tournament to select players for the national team for the Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
 
 
• **Famous sports and trophies associated-**
 
 
 
 

 **Hockey**
 Agha Khan Cup, Dhyan Chand Trophy, Azlan Shah Cup, Indira Gandhi Gold Cup, Rangaswami Cup
 
 

 **Cricket **
 C.K.Naidu Trophy, Deodhar Trophy, Duleep Trophy, Irani Trophy, Ranji Trophy
 
 

 **Tennis**
 Davis Cup, Billie Jean King Cup, Hopman Cup, Laver Cup, ATP Cup
 
 

 **Football **
 B.C. Roy Trophy, Bordoloi Trophy, Durand Cup, Nehru Gold Cup, Rovers Cup, Santosh Trophy, Subroto Cup
